gateHistory: Initial compile/test-fixture and scoped style findings were corrected. Full PostgreSQL/regression/style run passed; a final SQL text-block formatting-only adjustment was followed by resource tests and all scoped style/module-boundary gates plus complete Common installDist. Frontend packaging was enabled. The installed distribution was inspected independently.
verifiedScenarios: Same deployment operation gives host-independent module/client and owner/client plans; different operation gives fresh identities; invalid, shared, unselected and oversized clients reject.

First activation fences legacy clients without changing resource IDs; retirement and later activation cannot resurrect legacy/plugin authority; null and empty snapshots still check deployment authority.
Exact batch retries accept reordered inputs; same operation cannot change, add or remove owners; stale operations, clients and expected generations reject.
Conflicting multi-owner batches and outer transaction rollback preserve all prior states; concurrent installers have one CAS winner.
Registration and activation share the database row lock; activation waits for in-flight snapshots, and subsequent old calls reject.
Missing V5 table fails closed; actual JSON dispatch returns stable generation rejection and exposes neither old v2 nor local administration.
Signed JWT isolation/authorization and provider identity forwarding regression pass; these are separate from real database generation tests.
Actual V3/V4-to-V5 migrations preserve resources, revoked grants, catalog revision and deployment history; shared/split identity storage binding and manifest ownership checks pass.

Installed Common distribution contains exact V5/manifest, unique v3 contract/provider/planner/authority classes, mandatory local isolation, non-remote deployment administration, both error locales and all declared federation assets.
limitations: Resource concurrency tests use distinct services/physical PostgreSQL transactions in one JVM, not separately deployed JVMs. Resource fixtures use real V4/V5 SQL and ORM-created remaining tables, with grant/tenant collaborators mocked; actual installer migration tests are separate.

Signed JWT tests use an explicit domain mock; real generation JSON tests use trusted test identity plus real domain transactions. External OAuth issuance/rotation and full deployed authentication were not tested.

Composition verification is filtered to seven named classes, not its full suite. Scoped style excludes three pre-existing large Common HTTP fixtures whose only change was constructor mocks; the full Common test suite passed.

Generation authority is a local trusted installation port, not yet invoked by a formal installer. OAuth provisioning, complete policy/config publication, credential revocation, stale writer retirement, legacy owner adoption and recovery orchestration remain incomplete.
Publisher retirement preserves resources/grants; it is not business resource offline or a global service lease. Old binaries with direct database write privileges must be retired explicitly.

Common installDist was rebuilt with frontend enabled, but no deployment, production database/config write, commit or push occurred. Served UI/browser and real multi-process topology validation remain outstanding.
Formal standalone host, remaining HTTP/frontend/security composition and complete three-topology business/failure/upgrade acceptance remain required.
